text:
customer_jane: We're seeing intermittent 503s and timeouts hitting /v1/generate from eu-west1 since ~09:20 UTC. SDK v1.3.2. Request id: req_6128609123. ~20% of requests failing, streaming truncated. Any ETA?

anya_support: Sorry about that — escalating. Can you paste a sample curl and the X-Request-ID from response headers? Also how many parallel connections are you opening?

customer_jane: here's sample curl we used:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
We open ~150 parallel per host, using default SDK keepalive.

anya_support: thx — looping in @matt_oncall and @kai_eng to investigate.

matt_oncall: looking at prod traces for req_6128609123 — I see lots of 503s from edge-proxy: "upstream connect error or disconnect". Can you repro with a small script? Also does disabling streaming change anything?

kai_eng: fyi, curious if this is NAT/ephemeral port exhaustion at the edge. Can you run this toy test from your host to simulate fanout:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done; wait
```
Also try forcing HTTP/1.1: `--http1.1`.

customer_jane: ran your loop. Results: ~40% requests returned 503 quickly, others ok. Forcing HTTP/1.1 lowered failures to ~10%. Attached small log excerpt:
"2026-03-17T09:22:11Z edge-proxy[eu-west1] upstream connect error: no healthy upstream"

julia_se: short-term mitigation: enable exponential backoff in SDK and reduce concurrent connections to 50 per host. We'll send recommended SDK config snippet.

kai_eng: pulled edge logs — snippet:
"[proxy] 2026-03-17T09:22:10Z conn_limit reached, syn_reuse, conntrack_full"
"[upstream] 503 upstream connect timeout (ephemeral ports exhausted)"
Looks like connection tracking table saturated during heavy fanout from this tenant.

ops_bot: ALERT: conntrack_utilization=98% host=edge-eu-west1 at 2026-03-17T09:22:15Z

matt_oncall: infra plan: increase conntrack & keepalive timeout on edge for eu-west1 (short-term), add tenant-level token throttling (medium-term). We'll push a config today; ETA ~2h. Also rolling patch to edge to prefer reuse (keep-alive tuning).

anya_support: drafting update to customer: recommend SDK backoff + reduce concurrency immediately. Infra will apply edge config in ~2h. We'll monitor and update in-thread.

customer_jane: thanks. Do you need any info from our side? We can toggle backoff quickly.

anya_support: please enable SDK backoff and set max_concurrency=50. Send us a new request id after change so we can verify. We'll message when infra change complete.

kai_eng: follow-up: we pushed conntrack increase and adjusted proxy keepalive. Early metrics show 503 rate down to <2% for the tenant. We'll keep monitoring for 24h.

anya_support: update sent to customer. Closing loop when you confirm post-change results.

customer_jane: confirmed — after SDK change + infra tweak failures <1% now. Really appreciate the quick help :tada:

matt_oncall: leaving note for postmortem: consider automatic tenant fanout detection and per-tenant circuit-breaker to avoid future conntrack saturation.
